slides.say: Use insertion effect exists for one job: CSS in JS libraries injecting style tags.
It runs before any layout Effects fire, so styles are in place before layout effects read the layout.

slides.text: No state updates inside. Refs aren’t attached yet.
slides.say: You cannot update state inside it, and refs are not attached yet when it runs.

slides.text: Not writing a CSS-in-JS library? Use useEffect or useLayoutEffect.
slides.say: If you are not building a CSS in JS library, you want use effect or use layout effect instead.
